idx=np.argsort(t)

# fit linear regression on basic features to see structure
A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),t,x,v,np.sqrt(v),x*v,v**2,x**2,np.exp(-t)])
c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
pred=A@c
print(c.round(4), 1-np.sum((dv_dt-pred)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2))
for i in range(0,300,30): print(t[i].round(3),x[i].round(3),v[i].round(3),dv_dt[i].round(4))

import itertools
grid=[-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2,3]
P=[]
labels=[]
for p,q,r in itertools.product(grid,grid,grid):
    if (p,q,r)==(0,0,0): continue
    P.append(t**p*x**q*v**r); labels.append((p,q,r))
P=np.array(P)  # n x 300
# Also single-term pairs with sqrt(v) basis
y=dv_dt
sv=np.sqrt(v)
# project out sv
def proj_out(a,b):
    return b - a*(a@b)/(a@a)
Pr=np.array([proj_out(sv,p) for p in P])
yr=proj_out(sv,y)
# for each pair, least squares of yr on two columns
best=[]
n=len(P)
nrm=np.sum(yr**2)
for i in range(n):
    a=Pr[i]
    aa=a@a
    if aa<1e-12: continue
    # two-term via normal equations for all j
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        b=Pr[j]
        G=np.array([[aa,a@b],[a@b,b@b]])
        rhs=np.array([a@yr,b@yr])
        try:
            c=np.linalg.solve(G,rhs)
        except Exception: continue
        rss=nrm-c@rhs
        best.append((rss/nrm,labels[i],labels[j]))
best.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
print(len(best))
